name: Salt Lake County, UT
findings: Salt Lake County has 3,412 nonprofit organizations. 1,418 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,116 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Salt Lake County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Salt Lake County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).
